messages:
sara: Quick sync — I pushed an initial skeleton for 'iac-orchard' to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/iac-orchard
sara: Goal is a small collection of opinionated terraform modules + a lightweight marketplace packaging flow for AWS/GCP/Azure. Keep partner onboarding <10min if possible.
james: Nice. Can we scope what 'one-click' means here? Marketplace packaging often needs platform-specific metadata and legal fields.
leo: Agree. From eng side I'd propose: modules must accept a small set of canonical inputs (region, instance_type, vpc_id, tags) and output a wrapper dir with marketplace metadata.
leo: Example module usage:

```
module "refarch" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/iac-orchard//modules/refarch"
  region = var.region
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  tags = var.tags
}
```

leo: CI should run `terraform validate` + `tflint`, then a packager job creates platform bundles (AMI or image, metadata JSON/YAML).
puneet: For AWS we need AMI baking + CloudFormation wrapper; GCP wants a marketplace image + a deployment template; Azure needs an ARM/template variant. Packager should be a plugin system.
maya: Docs will need two artifacts: 1) Partner quickstart (5 min) and 2) Security & compliance checklist (KMS, IAM least privilege, VPC egress). I'll draft templates.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace guidelines updated 2025-01-12 — see https://partners.example.com/guidelines (ensure license and support fields present).
sara: Proposed deliverables by EOW: 1) module scaffolding for refarch + inference-service, 2) CI packager prototype that emits a sample AWS bundle, 3) partner quickstart draft.
james: I'll loop in BD and partner PMs to get early review from CloudPartnerX and SI partners.
leo: I'll open PRs for the modules today; will include a minimal example and test workspace.
puneet: Can someone add a short note about network topology requirements (private subnets, NAT, outbound ports for model pull)? I can add concrete port ranges and recommendations.
maya: On it. Also adding a placeholder section for enterprise legal metadata (SLA, license, upload contact).
sara: Great. Reconvene Thurs 11am PT. If anyone hits blockers, drop notes here and tag @sara.
leo: :thumbsup:
james: :rocket:
